Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] As Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) Market Value Rose, Bell State Bank & Trust Cut Its Position; Apple (AAPL) Stock Value Rose While Saturna Capital Raised Position by $1.76 Million 
March 4, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Bell State Bank & Trust decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) by 53.69% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bell State Bank & Trust sold 3,265 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 2,816 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $318,000, down from 6,081 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bell State Bank & Trust who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $42.64 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.26% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $124.09. About 2.90M shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 24.67% since March 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.97% the S&P500. 
Saturna Capital Corp increased its stake in Apple (AAPL) by 1.87% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Saturna Capital Corp bought 11,425 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 621,223 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $96.04M, up from 609,798 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Saturna Capital Corp who had been investing in Apple for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $894.09 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.69% or $1.21 during the last trading session, reaching $176.21. About 38.45 million shares traded or 8.44% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Among 28 analysts covering NXP Semiconductors NV ( NASDAQ:NXPI ), 8 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 19 Hold. Therefore 29% are positive. NXP Semiconductors NV had 64 analyst reports since August 3, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, February 5 by Topeka Capital Markets. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Robert W. Baird given on Tuesday, August 2. The stock has “Hold” rating by Oppenheimer on Thursday, August 3. The stock of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has “Neutral” rating given on Wednesday, February 3 by Goldman Sachs. As per Thursday, October 26, the company rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird. Canaccord Genuity maintained NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) rating on Monday, July 10. Canaccord Genuity has “Hold” rating and $11000 target. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, October 27 by Mizuho. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Thursday, October 26 by Jefferies. Needham maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Thursday, September 7 report. Mizuho maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Wednesday, May 31 report. 
Analysts await NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) to report earnings on May, 2. They expect $1.44 earnings per share, down 11.11% or $0.18 from last year’s $1.62 per share. NXPI’s profit will be $494.85 million for 21.54 P/E if the $1.44 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.06 actual earnings per share reported by NXP Semiconductors N.V. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -52.94% negative EPS growth.

The rating was maintained by Maxim Group on Wednesday, August 2 with “Buy”. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Barclays Capital given on Wednesday, January 27.
